summary: A six-story board-formed concrete warehouse of 1941-44 (256 ft by 77 ft, 98,804 sq ft) north of Building 12, one of the three historic buildings Brookfield must rehabilitate to the Secretary of the Interior's Standards under the Pier 70 DDA. It is a Phase 1 option parcel to be held on a 99-year lease at an appraised rent; a 2021 filing described about 120 apartments in its shell, Brookfield now markets it as creative office, and the Port's proposed 2026 amendments would have the developer assign its option and close escrow within six months of Board approval, with certain impact fees and special taxes waived. No rehabilitation has started.

milestones.text: Built during World War II as Warehouse No. 2 to support hull construction at the Building 12 complex; sixth floor with drafting room added 1944
Listed as a contributing resource of the Union Iron Works Historic District

DDA terms approved: Historic Building 2 is an option parcel to be developed under a 99-year lease consistent with the Secretary's Standards, at a fair market rent set by appraisal that accounts for rehabilitation costs and historic tax credits
Development agreement filing summarized: Building 2 to be rehabilitated into approximately 120 dwelling units (approximately 110,000 gsf)

Proposed DDA amendment: developer to assign its Building 2 option and close escrow within six months of Board approval of the amendments; certain impact fees and special taxes waived 'given the high costs of historic rehabilitation'

open_questions: No appraisal, lease, permit or construction record for Building 2 was found; the Port's June 2025 deck does not mention it and the 2026 report says no Phase 1 option has been exercised.

Which program is current: the 2021 filing's ~120 apartments or the leasing page's creative office. A June 2024 Chronicle piece reportedly describes the 2019 apartment plan as put on hold, but it could not be read (HTTP 403).
The RSF figure (~100,000) on Brookfield's brochure noted in the geometry file could not be verified; the NRHP gross area is 98,804 sq ft.
The 2026 memo's 'assign its option' language implies a third-party vertical developer for Building 2; none is named.
